CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayAvg

Adds up every element of a one-dimensional array and divides by the number of elements.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayAvg(array)

Parameters

array
A one-dimensional array whose elements are all numbers (or strings that look like numbers).

Returns

The average as a number. An empty array returns 0.

Usage

If any element is not numeric, KoldFusion throws an Expression exception ("Non-numeric value in array"). Related functions: ArraySum, ArrayMin, ArrayMax.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Average of five modem connection speeds --->
<CFSET Speeds = ListToArray("28.8,33.6,56,14.4,56")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Speeds (Kbps)</TH><TD>#ArrayToList(Speeds, ", ")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TH>ArrayAvg</TH><TD>#NumberFormat(ArrayAvg(Speeds), "__.__")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TH>ArraySum</TH><TD>#ArraySum(Speeds)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArraySum, ArrayMin, ArrayMax, ListToArray
